name: Magsarion
source:
Heretical warrior of the Ashavan (side of good) regarded as dangerous by even his own compatriots.
His martial talent itself is ordinary, but with only a manic drive and his resentful determination to exterminate evil as his weapon, the wicked warrior continues his bloody battle.


[spoiler]The second Hegemony God to sit on the Throne as well as the creator of the world of [url=https://vndb.org/v1951]Paradise Lost[/url].[/spoiler]
